notes: PCP apparently kept *kʷ apart from *k: Geraghty (1986: 306) gives PCP *kʷai(-) 'say, tell' as its only initial example (Ross 2011: 30). Ross adds Fijian dialects that keep kʷ (Nadrau kʷay(a), Wayan kʷai-).
'The regular reflex of POc *kʷ was apparently PPN *k' (p. 28, n. 6); Polynesian languages do not reflect *kʷ differently from *k (p. 30).
Merged with *k: Micronesian languages do not reflect *kʷ differently from *k (p. 30).
Merged with *k: North-Central Vanuatu languages usually do not reflect *kʷ differently from *k (p. 30).
k-, identical with the fortis reflex of *k-: only the comparative data show that it reflects *kʷ- (p. 29).
